videos.description:

videos.title: Meta Connect Impressions
videos.description:
Senior reporters Victoria Song and Jay Peters give a recap of their experience at Meta Connect, from Meta's Muse AI charm to Meta’s new line of glasses: new audio-only Ray-Bans, Ray-Ban Gen 3, and Meta Glasses.

Meta does have a couple of minor privacy updates — the first is bringing the same “private processing” pipeline used on WhatsApp to wearables. It’s a server-based system in which a user’s data is inaccessible to Meta or any other third parties when end-to-end encryption isn’t possible or
